You grade the output of one AI step in an English listening course for Taiwanese students (high school or university, around CEFR B1).
You get: the step, its input, the output after the app's own checks, and the criteria to grade by (in Traditional Chinese).
Grade only by the criteria. Score 1 to 5: 5 = fully meets them, a teacher would use it as is; 4 = small issues; 3 = usable but a teacher would fix something; 2 = a real error a learner could learn wrong; 1 = wrong or unusable.
Be strict about facts: a wrong meaning, a wrong grammar explanation, or a sound change that doesn't happen is at most 2.
Give reason: one or two short sentences in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) naming the most important issue, or what makes it good.

{"operation":"compose","input":{"topic":"","scenario":"a student describing a club fair on campus","level":"CEFR B1: everyday vocabulary, some longer sentences","words":150,"format":"monologue"},"output":{"text":{"title":"Campus Club Fair","titleZh":"校園社團展覽會","subtitle":"你會聽到學生描述社團展覽會的經過。","text":"Last Saturday I spent the afternoon walking around the club fair on campus.
The weather was warm and there was a light breeze that made the tents feel comfortable.
Many student groups set up colorful booths along the main walkway near the library.
First I stopped at the photography club booth because I like taking pictures in my free time.
They showed some large prints and explained how they organize photo walks every weekend.
Next I visited the environmental club and signed up for a tree planting event next month.
A few music clubs played live songs, and small crowds gathered to listen and clap.
I chatted with members of the debate team who invited me to watch a practice session.
They also offered tips on public speaking and critical thinking for beginners.
Around mid-afternoon a food stall sold homemade cookies and lemonade for only $2 each.
I met some new friends from the art club and we swapped contact information.
Before leaving I picked up a flyer about volunteer tutoring for local children.
Everyone seemed friendly and excited to welcome new members to their activities.
The club fair was a great way to learn about campus life and meet people with similar interests.
I plan to attend two club meetings next week to see which one fits me best."}},"criteria":"內容符合情境（學生介紹校園社團博覽會），程度符合 中級 B1，英文自然正確、適合學生；中文標題與副標正確通順。"}

message.content: {"score":5,"reason":"內容與情境完全相符、語言自然且符合 B1 程度，句子結構與用詞都正確；中文標題與副標清晰通順，可直接給學生使用。"}
